 "topology": "6T CMOS Schmitt (inverting) + output inverter",
 "rationale": "The 6T Schmitt's feedback devices are ratioed against stack devices of the same type, so thresholds track across corners. A feedback-to-stack ratio of at least 1 gives about 1 V hysteresis at 1.62 V. The pfet's high |Vth| also pushes vth_lo low. Long-L devices (L=2 um) limit the M1/M3 and M4/M6 crowbar current to under about 10 uA peak, for an average under about 25 uW. Both stages swing rail-to-rail, and the output inverter makes the response non-inverting."}

PARAMS = {
    "Wn":   (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # nfet input stack M1/M2 width [um]
    "Wnf":  (1.5, 0.42, 6.0),   # nfet feedback M3 width [um]
    "Wp":   (2.0, 0.42, 8.0),   # pfet input stack M4/M5 width [um]
    "Wpf":  (2.0, 0.42, 8.0),   # pfet feedback M6 width [um]
    "Ls":   (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),    # Schmitt-core channel length [um]
    "Winv": (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter nfet width [um] (pfet = 2x)
    "Linv": (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),   # output inverter length [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    Wn, Wnf, Wp, Wpf, Ls = p["Wn"], p["Wnf"], p["Wp"], p["Wpf"], p["Ls"]
    Winv, Linv = p["Winv"], p["Linv"]

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss")
    # NMOS stack: M1 bottom, M2 top; M3 feedback from vdd into x (gate = o1)
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ls)
    n.M("M2", "o1", "vin", "x", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ls)
    n.M("M3", "vdd", "o1", "x", "vss", "nfet", Wnf, Ls)
    # PMOS stack: M4 top, M5 bottom; M6 feedback from y to vss (gate = o1)
    n.M("M4", "y", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Ls)
    n.M("M5", "o1", "vin", "y", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Ls)
    n.M("M6", "vss", "o1", "y", "vdd", "pfet", Wpf, Ls)
    # Output inverter -> non-inverting overall, rail-to-rail
    n.M("M7", "vout", "o1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Winv, Linv)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Winv, Linv)

    # ---- first-order threshold model (square law, equal L) ----
    VDD = 1.8
    vtn, vtn_b = 0.62, 0.72     # nfet Vth without/with body effect (source at x)
    vtp, vtp_b = 0.98, 1.08     # pfet |Vth|
    rn = Wnf / Wn               # feedback strength ratio, n side
    rp = Wpf / Wp
    # n side: M3 (sat) current equals M1 current at the trip point, vin = Vx + Vt
    vx = math.sqrt(rn) * (VDD - vtn_b) / (1 + math.sqrt(rn))
    vth_hi = min(vx + vtn_b, VDD - 0.1)
    # p side (mirror image)
    sy = math.sqrt(rp) * (VDD - vtp_b) / (1 + math.sqrt(rp))   # VDD - Vy
    vy = VDD - sy
    vth_lo = max(vy - vtp_b, 0.05)
    hyst = vth_hi - vth_lo

    # ---- power: crowbar current through M3+M1 (rising) and M4+M6 (falling) ----
    kn = 0.5 * 270e-6 * Wn / Ls
    kp = 0.5 * 70e-6 * Wp / Ls
    In_pk = kn * max(vx, 0.1) ** 2
    Ip_pk = kp * max(sy, 0.1) ** 2
    # each conducts for roughly half of its ramp half-period; triangular-ish shape
    frac_n = max(vth_hi - vtn, 0) / VDD * 0.5
    frac_p = max(VDD - vtp - vth_lo, 0) / VDD * 0.5
    I_avg = 0.5 * (In_pk * frac_n + Ip_pk * frac_p) + 1e-6   # +1 uA inverter/switching
    power = 1.98 * I_avg * 1.5   # worst-case supply and ff margin

    return n, {"vth_hi": vth_hi, "vth_lo": vth_lo,
               "hysteresis": hyst, "power_avg": power}
